capstone-system-diagnostics.service.content:
[Unit]
Description=Bounded read-only Capstone system diagnostics
After=systemd-journald.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=capstone-diagnostics
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -IB /opt/capstone-diagnostics/system_diagnostics.py --collect --role security
UMask=0027
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/capstone-diagnostics
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
KillMode=control-group
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryHigh=192M
MemoryMax=256M
MemorySwapMax=0
TasksAccounting=yes
TasksMax=64
LimitNOFILE=1024
TimeoutStartSec=85
TimeoutStopSec=5

[Timer]

capstone-journal-reader.service.content:
[Unit]
Description=Fixed-unit masked journal excerpt reader
After=systemd-journald.service
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=capstone-diagnostics
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -IB /opt/capstone-diagnostics/system_diagnostics.py --serve-journal --role security
RuntimeDirectory=capstone-journal
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
UMask=0007
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateNetwork=yes
ReadWritePaths=/run/capstone-journal
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
KillMode=control-group
MemoryMax=128M
TasksMax=8
LimitNOFILE=1024
TimeoutStopSec=10
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
